woods.title: CSC 213: Digital Logic Design (course book)
woods.publisher: Department of Computer Science, University of Ibadan

tocci.title: Digital Systems: Principles and Applications
tocci.authors: Ronald J. Tocci and Neal S. Widmer

alexander.title: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits
alexander.authors: Charles K. Alexander and Matthew N. O. Sadiku

circuit-theory.why: The course's own treatment of Kirchhoff's laws and the Thevenin and Norton examples.

circuit-theory.read: The chapters on basic laws and circuit theorems (Kirchhoff's laws, Thevenin's and Norton's theorems)
circuit-theory.why: A standard circuits textbook in the course folder, with many worked examples.

semiconductors-and-transistors.read: Lectures Two and Three: Semiconductors I and II
semiconductors-and-transistors.why: The course's notes on doping, the P-N junction, diodes, BJTs and FETs.

semiconductors-and-transistors.read: The chapters on semiconductors, diodes and transistors
semiconductors-and-transistors.why: Cited by the course book and filed in the course folder.

logic-families-and-gates.read: Lectures Four and Five: Digital Logic Families and Digital Logic Gates
logic-families-and-gates.why: Covers the TTL and CMOS characteristics and gate truth tables the exams ask about.

logic-families-and-gates.read: The chapters on logic gates and Boolean algebra, and on integrated-circuit logic families
logic-families-and-gates.why: The digital systems textbook the course book cites.

combinational-logic-and-standard-forms.read: Lectures Six and Seven: Combinational Logic Design and Standard Forms of Expression
combinational-logic-and-standard-forms.why: The course's method for truth tables, expressions, diagrams, SOP and POS.

combinational-logic-and-standard-forms.read: The chapter on combinational logic circuits (sum-of-products form and circuit design)
combinational-logic-and-standard-forms.why: More worked design problems like the exam's word problems.

minimisation-and-standard-circuits.read: Lectures Eight and Nine: Switching Function Minimization and Standard Combinational Logic Circuits
minimisation-and-standard-circuits.why: The course's K-map, Quine-McCluskey, adder and multiplexer material.

minimisation-and-standard-circuits.read: The chapters on Karnaugh maps, arithmetic circuits and MSI logic circuits (decoders, encoders, multiplexers)

sequential-circuits-and-codes.read: Lectures Ten to Thirteen: Sequential Logic, Registers and Counters, Computer Codes, Error Detection
sequential-circuits-and-codes.why: The course's notes on flip-flops, counters, codes, parity and Hamming codes.

sequential-circuits-and-codes.read: The chapters on number systems and codes, flip-flops, and counters and registers
sequential-circuits-and-codes.why: Fuller treatment of counters and codes.
